title: struct2table
summary: Convert scalar structs or struct arrays into tables.

gpu_support.notes: Struct and table containers are host values.

description: `struct2table(S)` converts struct fields into table variables. Scalar structs become variable columns, while struct arrays become row-oriented tables.
behaviors: Field insertion order becomes variable order.
Compatible field values from a struct array become homogeneous table variables. Same-class integer fields retain their exact class and values; incompatible fields remain cell variables.
`"VariableNames"` and `"RowNames"` may be supplied as name-value options.
`"AsArray"` keeps scalar struct field values as array-valued table entries and accepts logical or numeric scalar values exactly equal to zero or one.

examples.description: Preserve scalar struct arrays as entries
